items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: here's Princess Margaret and all of them like that

ctx.x: He said, if you see a horse, you know that's a horse, don't you? If you see a rose, you know -- I couldn't believe it, what he was talking. I told Billy Kyle Collins, and he laid on the floor laughing. I couldn't believe it. This guy -- laughed about two weeks until my stomach hurt me. I didn't know whether he was putting me on or whether he really, really believed it, but I couldn't believe it. I just couldn't -- these things -- he used to come on right out of the clear sky with, things like you just couldn't…

I couldn't believe things that he used to tell me, like funny, man. But, yeah, we go in Europe, and here's Princess Margaret and all of them like that, asking him about -- questions about things, and he's sitting up there having court with these big people.
